name: JSON to Markdown Table
summary: Convert a JSON array of objects to a GitHub-flavored Markdown pipe table.
description: Paste JSON (array of objects) and get a ready-to-paste Markdown table for README files and docs. Options: pretty column padding, sort keys A–Z, column alignment. Nested values are JSON-stringified in cells.

faqs.question: What JSON shape is required?
faqs.answer: A JSON array where each item is a plain object. Keys become column headers; values become cell text.

faqs.question: How are nested objects handled?
faqs.answer: Objects and arrays are serialized with JSON.stringify so the table stays valid.

faqs.question: How are columns ordered?
faqs.answer: By default, keys follow first-seen order across rows. Enable “Sort column keys A–Z” for alphabetical headers.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
